other_conditions: University/Institution must be a legal entity under Indian law with at least 51% Indian stakeholders
Applicant institution should be located in Tier II/III cities (encouraged)
Institution may be public (Central/State) or private owned
Must have a Department in the Life Sciences stream (Biotechnology, Biosciences, Agriculture, Horticulture, Food Technology, etc.)
Institution age must be at least 3 years
Must have an innovation‑supporting body such as an E‑Cell, Institutional Innovation Council, IP Cell, TTO or Incubation centre
Must provide dedicated space of approximately 3,000 sq ft. with relevant infrastructure ready for use
Must be connected with a Bio‑incubator
Must have a network of experts for technical/business mentorship to fellows
Head of the University/Institution must appoint/nominate a Project Lead as the contact point for BIRAC EYC
Applications must be routed through the Head of the University/Institution and submitted online via the BIRAC website
benefits_summary: Provides up to INR 107.5 lakh over three years for infrastructure setup, recurring operational costs, workshops and mentorship to E‑YUVA Centers
